payload.artist_html: Maria Belen von Baczko, Julia Brenda Desojo
payload.description_html:
Skull of Riojasuchus tenuisceps in right lateral view.

(A) Holotype PVL 3827; (B) reconstruction. Abbreviations: An, angular; AOF, antorbital fenestra; Aofo, antorbital fossa; CN V, exit for cranial nerve V; De, dentary; EMF, external mandibular fenestra; EN, external nares; Fr, frontal; ITF, infratemporal fenestra; J, jugal; J.pb, protuberance of the jugal; J.vp, vertical process of the jugal; La, lacrimal; La.p, pocket on the lacrimal; Ls, laterosphenoid; Mx, maxilla; N, nasal; O, orbit; Op, opisthotic; Pa, parietal; Pfr, prefrontal; Pl, palatine; Pmx, premaxilla; Pmx,pp, palatal process of the premaxilla; Po, postorbital; Pof, postfrontal; Pp, paroccipital process; Pr, prootic; Q, quadrate; Qj, quadratojugal; Sa, surangular; Sa.sh, surangular shelf; Sq, squamosal; STF, supratemporal fenestra. Scale bar: 1cm.
